items.editor_note: BetaNews reports Z.ai delayed the GLM 5.3 release over cybersecurity risks.

editorial.tldr: Z.ai CEO Jie Tang laid out GLM 5.3's post-training scaling-law approach the same day an independent hands-on review covered GLM 5's features and pricing. Two days later, the company confirmed the follow-up release wasn't shipping on schedule.
editorial.whats_new: Z.ai delayed the GLM 5.3 release over cybersecurity risks, per BetaNews's Aug 22 report.
editorial.why_it_matters: Platform engineers evaluating GLM 5.3 as an open-weight option should expect a slipped release date and treat any leaked or early build with extra scrutiny until Z.ai discloses what triggered the review.
editorial.take_for_builders: Hold off pinning a GLM 5.3 version until Z.ai names a new release date, and track its disclosures for the specific cybersecurity risk before evaluating it as a coding backend.

status.detail: GLM 5.3's release is on hold pending a security review; Z.ai has not disclosed the specific risk or a new ship date.
